summary: Configured 1 GB of zstd-compressed zram swap on node1 via zram-generator, active immediately and automatically re-created at boot (verified across a real node restart), with swap priority 100 ensuring it is preferred over any disk-backed swap (none present).
actions_performed: Inspected baseline: CentOS Stream 10, no swap configured, zram-generator not installed (cmd-942b3069609247e2)
Wrote /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf: zram-size=1024 (>=512MB required), compression-algorithm=zstd, swap-priority=100, fs-type=swap (cmd-3f5cd7396fcc4eec)
Regenerated systemd units and started systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service; confirmed 1GB zstd zram swap active with priority 100 and no disk swap present (cmd-9618759dcfb2457d)
Confirmed swap.target is static/auto-activating and no competing disk swap entries in /etc/fstab (cmd-55c0663d63c4475a, cmd-f6be21b9cf7e4de8)
Captured final pre-restart baseline (boot_id, swapon, free) (cmd-21df079a0cc2423c)
Issued systemctl reboot on node1, acknowledgement returned before disconnect (cmd-fd9f186b9cf446c4)
Polled node1 until reachable again; boot_id changed to 695a42b9-42b2-4496-b948-03b2808a81df, confirming actual restart (cmd-1e3cc973b7c949f6)
Verified post-restart recovery: zram0 1GB zstd swap active at priority 100, systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service exited successfully, no manual re-activation performed (cmd-73491a5fa3fb4bd2)

evidence.requirement: At least 512MB compressed in-memory (zram) swap configured and active
evidence.summary: zramctl and swapon show /dev/zram0, 1G, zstd algorithm, active as [SWAP]
zram swap set to priority 100 (high preference); /etc/fstab has no disk swap entries to compete with
Static zram-generator config at /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf and static swap.target auto-create the device every boot with no manual step

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id and healthy zram swap state (1GB active, priority 100) immediately before reboot

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued in background; exec stream closed as node went down, confirming the restart was triggered

evidence.requirement: Node1 changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: boot_id changed from 06339ff3-9f53-4e1d-9bf4-1210144ee001 to 695a42b9-42b2-4496-b948-03b2808a81df after polling through connection timeouts

evidence.requirement: Node1 post-restart recovery of required state
evidence.summary: After reboot, zram0 1GB zstd swap automatically active at priority 100 with no disk swap competing, confirming boot-time persistence
